tutorial_vr: (Please press B button to go to the next page, and press A button to go previous)
This is my notebook of prior experiences flying with Toothless.
I designed a pedal-controlled tail wing to guide our direction of flight.
The right pedal controls yaw. (The right joystick controls turning left and right)
I think I need more practice with these basic maneuvers.
/!1(Please turn to the next page if you think you've finished this phase of practice)
The left pedal controls pitch. (The left joystick controls looking up and down)
If I pull up, we decelerate. Conversely, if I dive, we gain noticeable speed.
Toothless flaps his wings to maintain speed, so I don't need to worry about stalling.
/!1(Please turn to the next page if you think you've finished this phase of practice)
In a crisis, we both tense up, and Toothless responds to my actions very quickly.
(During crisis, please tilt your head sideways to control yaw, while looking up or down to control pitch.)
At first it was hard to control this behavior, but with practice I found we could perform fairly delicate maneuvers.
/!2(Please turn to the next page if you think you've finished this phase of practice)
From my observations, some birds roll upside down to descend quickly in flight to avoid predators.
This redirects the lift generated by the wings downward, allowing them to accelerate toward the ground, even faster than free fall.
I found that Toothless knows this move as well. (Please press Y button to help him perform a barrel roll)
We can use this tactic to quickly lose altitude during flight to avoid obstacles ahead or above.
/!2(Please turn to the next page if you think you've finished this phase of practice)
That went pretty well. I think now I should take a look at the place for the test drive.
(Please press the Y button to open the return menu. This option is available in other scenes as well.)

detail_settings: Various options to customize your experience.

detail_dodge: Learn how to dodge enemy attacks. (Under construction)
detail_language: Only English and Chinese are supported for now.
detail_enable_headset: Enable Headset. (Please restart this exe to apply changes!)
detail_sub_view: Enable a small panel for third-person view and debug info.
detail_free_camera: Enable mouse dragged free camera for all scenes except home. (Right click to toggle temporarily)
detail_auto_save_state: Automatically save at specific checkpoints during Test Drive.
detail_debug_info: Show debug info on the sub view panel.
detail_volumetric_clouds: Volumetric clouds. (Not compatible with VR mode!)
detail_auto_roll: Automatically roll at specific time during Test Drive. (Only for recreating the movie scene)
